prompt: I am moving to the G40 postcode area - what train stations are nearby, as of 2024?
answer:
As of **2024**, the nearest railway stations to the **G40 postcode district in Glasgow** were:

| Station | Approximate proximity | Main ScotRail routes |
|---|---:|---|
| **Bridgeton** | Often the closest—about 0.3–0.9 miles, depending on the exact address | Argyle Line |
| **Dalmarnock** | About 0.3–0.7 miles in much of G40 | Argyle Line |
| **Bellgrove** | Roughly 0.4–1.3 miles | North Clyde Line |
| **Rutherglen** | Roughly 0.6–1.1 miles | Argyle, Shotts and Whifflet lines |
| **High Street (Glasgow)** | Around 0.9–1.5 miles | North Clyde and Argyle lines |
| **Duke Street** | Around 0.5–1.3 miles | North Clyde Line |
| **Alexandra Parade** | Around 0.9–1.8 miles | North Clyde Line |
| **Argyle Street** | Approximately 1.2–1.5 miles | Argyle Line |

For most parts of G40, **Bridgeton and Dalmarnock are the most convenient stations**. The exact nearest station depends on whether you are in the Bridgeton, Dalmarnock, Calton or Parkhead side of the postcode district. Distances are approximate and may differ by walking route.
